item.title: HbA1c Test Under Scrutiny: Are Diabetes Readings Always Reliable?
item.description: A Lancet discussion warns that HbA1c tests may not always be reliable in India, where anemia and nutritional deficiencies are common. HbA1c can overestimate or underestimate blood sugar levels, risking misdiagnosis. Experts recommend confirming diabetes with fasting plasma glucose, OGTT, or random glucose tests for accurate assessment.
